description: Updates an existing account in Salesforce with the specified changes. Only provided fields will be updated.

account_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the account to update.
account_id.human_parameter_description: The unique Salesforce ID of the account you want to update. You can copy it from the account's URL in Salesforce.
account_id.title: Account Id

account_source.description: Updated account source. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
account_source.human_parameter_description: Where this account originated from (e.g., Web, Partner, Trade Show) to track lead source.
account_source.title: Account Source

annual_revenue.description: Updated annual revenue. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
annual_revenue.human_parameter_description: Provide the company’s annual revenue amount to update their latest figure. Use a number only.
annual_revenue.title: Annual Revenue

billing_city.description: Updated billing city. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
billing_city.title: Billing City

billing_country.description: Updated billing country. Leave empty to keep unchanged. If your org has State and Country/Territory picklists enabled, provide the exact picklist value (e.g., 'United States' instead of 'USA').
billing_country.human_parameter_description: Country for the billing address. Use the exact picklist value if required (e.g., 'United States').
billing_country.title: Billing Country

billing_postal_code.description: Updated billing postal code. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
billing_postal_code.human_parameter_description: Postal or ZIP code for the billing address to ensure mail reaches the right place.
billing_postal_code.title: Billing Postal Code

billing_state.description: Updated billing state. Leave empty to keep unchanged. If your org has State and Country/Territory picklists enabled, provide the exact picklist value (e.g., 'California' instead of 'CA').
billing_state.human_parameter_description: State or province for the billing address. Use the exact picklist value if your org requires it (e.g., 'California').
billing_state.title: Billing State

billing_street.description: Updated billing street. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
billing_street.human_parameter_description: Street line of the billing address used for invoices and billing.
billing_street.title: Billing Street

custom_fields.description: Dictionary of custom field API names and their values. Custom field names typically end with '__c' (e.g., 'Level__c', 'Languages__c'). Values can be strings, numbers, booleans, or null depending on the field type.
custom_fields.human_parameter_description: Provide custom field values as key-value pairs. Use the API name of the custom field (ending in '__c') as the key. Example: {'Level__c': 'Gold', 'Custom_Score__c': 100}
custom_fields.title: Custom Fields

description.description: Updated description. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
description.human_parameter_description: Add a brief summary or notes about the account to give your team helpful context.
description.title: Description

fax.description: Updated fax number. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
fax.human_parameter_description: The company’s fax number, if you use it for communications.
fax.title: Fax

industry.description: Updated industry. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
industry.human_parameter_description: Specify the industry the company operates in (e.g., Technology, Healthcare) to keep reporting accurate.
industry.title: Industry

name.description: Updated account name. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
name.human_parameter_description: Enter the new name for the account if you want to rename it; leave it empty to keep the current name.
name.title: Name

number_of_employees.description: Updated number of employees. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
number_of_employees.human_parameter_description: Provide how many employees the company has to keep sizing info current. Use a whole number.
number_of_employees.title: Number Of Employees

parent_id.description: Updated parent account ID. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
parent_id.human_parameter_description: If this account should be linked under a parent, provide the parent account’s Salesforce ID so they’re connected.
parent_id.title: Parent Id

phone.description: Updated phone number. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
phone.human_parameter_description: The main phone number for the company. Include the country code if applicable.
phone.title: Phone

shipping_city.description: Updated shipping city. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
shipping_city.title: Shipping City

shipping_country.description: Updated shipping country. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
shipping_country.title: Shipping Country

shipping_postal_code.description: Updated shipping postal code. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
shipping_postal_code.human_parameter_description: Postal or ZIP code for the shipping address.
shipping_postal_code.title: Shipping Postal Code

shipping_state.description: Updated shipping state. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
shipping_state.human_parameter_description: State or province for the shipping address. Use the format your org expects (full name or abbreviation).
shipping_state.title: Shipping State

shipping_street.description: Updated shipping street. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
shipping_street.human_parameter_description: Street line of the shipping address used for deliveries or shipments.
shipping_street.title: Shipping Street

sic_desc.description: Updated SIC description. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
sic_desc.human_parameter_description: A short description of the company’s industry or SIC to clarify what they do.
sic_desc.title: Sic Desc

type.description: Updated account type. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
type.human_parameter_description: Choose how this account should be categorized (e.g., Customer, Partner, Prospect). Update it to reflect the relationship.
type.title: Type

website.description: Updated website URL. Leave empty to keep unchanged.
website.human_parameter_description: The company’s website address (for example, https://www.example.com) so teammates can quickly visit it.
website.title: Website

name: update_account

UpdateAccountResponse.description:
Response for successful account update.

HTTP 204 No Content - Salesforce returns empty body on successful update.
Error responses (4xx/5xx) are handled via raise_for_status().
UpdateAccountResponse.title: UpdateAccountResponse
